// diagnostic

E0932

`#Deprecated` requires a public item

What

`#Deprecated` requires a public item

Why

The lifecycle marker retires stable public declarations; private and package-public items remain on earlier ladder rungs

Fix

Write `pub` on the item, or remove `#Deprecated`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0932: tests/ui/deprecated_marker_private.stderr.

Error [E0932]: `#Deprecated` requires a public item

 Fix: write `pub` on the item, or remove `#Deprecated`
